title: wt status --json
description: What wt up would start on, from local state alone. Printed by `wt status [<work>] --json`, which writes nothing to any repository. Schema 1: fields may be added and enumerations may gain values; nothing is renamed or removed. See docs/json.md.

schema.description: The major version: a new one only for a change that breaks readers.

schemaVersion.description: The full semantic version of this schema that the output follows: minor for an added field or enumeration value, patch for wording.

token.description: Names the inputs of this plan (trunk name, wt configuration, stack); pass it to `wt up --expect`. Null when not eligible.

trunk.description: Trunk as wt up resolves it here.

trunkRef.description: origin/<trunk>, what wt up rebases onto after its fetch.

trunkRefUpdatedAt.description: When the trunk ref last moved, from its own reflog; null without one.

configured.description: The repository has a wt configuration that parses.

worktree.description: The worktree named; null when it cannot be found.

upEligible.description: wt up would start on it. Dirt, conflicts and busy sessions are not checked here.

stack.description: Every worktree wt up would move, parents first.

sessionsError.description: Listing the sessions failed; sessions is then empty, not known empty.

work.description: The work name, as wt list prints it.
